english.title: Conduct a mock auction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conducted a mock auction at which one or more lots of **(..SPECIFY ARTICLES FROM LIST IN SECTION 3(2)..) were offered for sale by way of competitive bidding and during the course of the sale

(A)_[a lot of **(..SPECIFY..) was sold to **(..SPECIFY..) at a price lower than the highest bid for the lot by that person]_
(B)_[a lot of **(..SPECIFY..) was sold to **(..SPECIFY..) and part of the price at which it was sold was repaid or credited to that person]_
(C)_[a lot of **(..SPECIFY..) was sold to **(..SPECIFY..) and part of the price at which it was sold was stated to be repaid or credited to that person]_
(D)_[the right to bid for any lot was restricted to persons who had bought or agreed to buy one or more articles]_
(E)_[the right to bid for any lot was stated to be restricted to persons who had bought or agreed to buy one or more articles]_
(F)_[articles were given away or offered as gifts]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (2) of the Mock Auctions Act 1961.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conducted a mock auction
at which one or more lots offered for sale by way of competitive bidding
and during course of sale lot sold at price lower than highest bid for that lot/part of price paid repaid or credited/part of price stated as repaid or credited/right to bid restricted to persons bought or agreed to buy one or more articles/right to bid stated as restricted to persons agree to buy one or more articles/articles given away or offered as gifts

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Offence Code and Offence Wording is OBSOLETE as from 26/05/08. Repealed by Part 1 of Schedule 4 to The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008.
